facts.label: No ponto de ônibus
facts.sub: Use how long para tempo e will para ofertas e palpites: How long does the trip take? I’ll call your boss. I think I’ll be late.

facts.label: Quanto tempo
facts.sub: Para perguntar o tempo de uma viagem, use How long does it take? ou How long does the trip take? Responda It takes forty minutes. Para esperar, use How long are you waiting?

facts.label: Will (ofertas)
facts.sub: Use will para oferecer algo na hora: I’ll call your boss. I’ll show you the stop. I’ll pay for both of us. Na fala, use ’ll. Depois de will, use o verbo base.

compare.ask: How long does the trip take?
compare.br: No Brasil, perguntamos “Quanto tempo leva?” e dizemos “eu pago”.
compare.tip: Diga: “How long does it take? I’ll pay.”
compare.us: Em inglês: How long does it take? e I’ll + verbo base para ofertas.

pages.title: A bus stop · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday morning at a bus stop in London. People stand in a long queue. Max looks at the timetable. His friend Gina comes with a paper cup. The shelter keeps them dry. Gina asks about the bus.
“Hi, Max! How long are you waiting for the bus?” says Gina. “About ten minutes. It’s late.” says Max. “How long does the trip take?” says Gina.
